crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding
crypto_headlines.summary: Lookonchain's Nov 26 update shows spot Bitcoin ETFs at -5,802 BTC (-$352.66M) for the day and -$2.51B over 7 days; ETH ETFs lost $73.16M on the day. Bitcoin ETFs are closing in on their largest monthly net outflow ever.

crypto_headlines.title: BTC dips under $57,500, then squeezes to $61,500
crypto_headlines.summary: Bitcoin fell below $57,500 with ETH near $1,600 and $500M in leveraged positions liquidated, then bounced to $61,500 with ETH back above $1,700 and $80M in shorts liquidated in 15 minutes.

crypto_headlines.title: US Strategic Bitcoin Reserve bill eligible for a full House vote
crypto_headlines.summary: If signed into law, the bill would bar the US from selling its Bitcoin reserves for at least 20 years.
